description: This file defines interfaces, data structures, and functions related to validation tags and validators in the Kubernetes code generator. It includes definitions for TagValidator, TypeValidator, FieldValidator, and associated validation logic, as well as metadata for validation tags.

methods.name: Function
methods.description: Creates a FunctionGen with specified tag name, flags, function name, and optional arguments.

methods.name: WithTypeArgs
methods.description: Returns a copy of FunctionGen with specified type arguments.

methods.name: WithConditions
methods.description: Returns a copy of FunctionGen with specified conditions.

methods.name: WithComments
methods.description: Returns a copy of FunctionGen with added comments.

methods.name: WithComment
methods.description: Returns a copy of FunctionGen with a single comment.

methods.name: WithStabilityLevel
methods.description: Returns a copy of FunctionGen with specified stability level.

methods.name: Variable
methods.description: Creates a VariableGen with specified variable name and initializer.
